response_contract_findings.generic_json_documentation: Describes JSON results as a top-level array of row objects.
response_contract_findings.soda3_query_documentation: Defines the endpoint and request options but does not publish an unambiguous response-envelope schema or a complete response example.
response_contract_findings.dataset_specific_examples: Show GET and POST request construction but do not establish the returned top-level JSON envelope.
response_contract_findings.soda2_vs_soda3: The generic row-array documentation is not sufficient to override the authenticated observation that this SODA3 endpoint returned valid non-array JSON.
response_contract_findings.conclusion: Current official documentation does not conclusively identify the observed SODA3 response shape; a one-request content-free shape diagnostic is required.
